mapper.select: SELECT id, inspection_type, target_company_id, target_vessel_id, inspection_date, inspector_user_id, findings, action_items, status, closed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_audit_inspection WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.inspection_type, a.target_company_id, c.name AS target_company_name, a.target_vessel_id, v.name AS target_vessel_name, a.inspection_date, a.inspector_user_id, u.name AS inspector_name, a.findings, a.action_items, a.status, a.closed_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM tb_audit_inspection a LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = a.target_company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = a.target_vessel_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = a.inspector_user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.inspection_type, a.target_company_id, c.name AS target_company_name, a.target_vessel_id, v.name AS target_vessel_name, a.inspection_date, a.inspector_user_id, u.name AS inspector_name, a.status, a.created_at FROM tb_audit_inspection a LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = a.target_company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = a.target_vessel_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = a.inspector_user_id AND u.deleted = 0
ORDER BY a.inspection_date DESC, a.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_audit_inspection ( inspection_type, target_company_id, target_vessel_id, inspection_date, inspector_user_id, findings, action_items, status, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{inspectionType}, #{targetCompanyId}, #{targetVesselId}, #{inspectionDate}, #{inspectorUserId}, #{findings}, #{actionItems}, #{status}'OPEN', SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_audit_inspection SET status = #{status}, closed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CLOSED' THEN SYSUTCDATETIME() ELSE closed_at END, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_audit_inspection SET deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
